page.content:
Voice of Night Vale Community Radio and the town's unofficial narrator.

How Cecil Palmer connects

  • Faction: Night Vale Community Radio — Cecil Palmer hosts Night Vale Community Radio.
  • Creator: Cecil Baldwin — Cecil Baldwin voices Cecil Palmer.
  • Location: Night Vale — Cecil Palmer lives in and narrates Night Vale.
  • Character: Carlos the Scientist — Cecil loves Carlos; they later marry.
  • Character: Kevin — Kevin is Cecil's Desert Bluffs double and rival host.
  • Faction: Station Management — Cecil works under Station Management and tries not to look at it.
  • Character: Steve Carlsberg — Steve Carlsberg is Cecil's despised, then tolerated, brother-in-law.

What is Cecil Palmer?

Cecil Palmer is the radio host who loves Carlos, fears the dog park, reports the City Council's edicts, and treats angels and intern deaths as the evening's public-service announcements.

Key threads lead to Night Vale Community Radio, Cecil Baldwin, Night Vale, Carlos the Scientist, Kevin and Station Management.
